summary: Lagged regression asymmetry test for H001: all cross-validated R² values are negative (cloud history → future albedo: R²_cv=-1.68; albedo → future cloud: R²_cv=-0.06). After deseasonalization, monthly global-mean albedo anomalies are essentially unpredictable from past cloud state at 3-12 month lags. This is CONSISTENT with the TE null result (A020) and confirms that the cloud-albedo causal relationship found by CCM (A019) and Granger (A008) operates through SYNCHRONOUS coupling rather than lagged predictability. The albedo anomaly appears to be driven by concurrent cloud cover rather than predictable from its cloud history. METHODOLOGICAL NOTE: Cross-validated R² < 0 means the lag model generalizes worse than simply predicting the mean — the signal is in the same-month relationship, not lags.
